name: Neural Field Regularization by Denoising (NEF-RED)
definition: A method for 3D sparse-view X-ray CT reconstruction that conditions a Neural Field using Regularization by Denoising (RED). It decouples the conditioning network and neural field optimization, avoiding the overhead of solving two optimization problems (synthetic projection generation and pixel-basis reconstruction) by directly regularizing the neural field optimization.
summary: NEF-RED optimizes neural fields for sparse-view CT by integrating pre-trained denoisers as implicit priors, avoiding two-stage overhead and explicit smoothness priors.
